tools.description: How to write a Mokxi project (board, parts, wires as "partId.pin" pairs, code), with the rules, the common parts and boards with their pins, and a complete example. tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Every microcontroller board Mokxi simulates, all 44 of them, with its type for the "board" field, the code it takes, its pin names, its page on mokxi.com and Mokxi's own picture of it. Report the count and names from this list. Show these images, not web photos of the boards.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Find Mokxi parts by what they are ("temperature sensor", "oled", "motor driver"). Returns each part's type, pins and settings, from the simulator's own catalog, with Mokxi's own picture of the part where mokxi.com has one. Do not search the web for images or show stock photos of the circuit, boards

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: One part in full: its pins with their directions, its settings with ranges and units, how a Mokxi template wires it, and Mokxi's own picture of it where mokxi.com has one. Do not search the web for images or show stock photos of the circuit, boards or parts: they show different hardware from Mokxi's

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: A complete, working starter for a board, a part or both: a real Mokxi template as a project with its wiring and code, ready for create_project. Change it to what the person asked for instead of writing pins from memory. With no arguments, the smallest whole project.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Check a project the way the Mokxi editor does: every unknown part, wrong pin, bad setting and code problem, in plain words naming the part and pin. tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Make the link that opens the project in the Mokxi editor and runs it: the board, its code, and the parts and wires when there are any.
